bullets.text: A motorcyclist died after falling into an open drainage pit in Ambattur, prompting severe criticism from opposition leaders over official negligence.
Authorities have issued urgent warnings for fishermen in Thiruvallur to return to shore as a depression forms in the Bay of Bengal.
A college student was arrested near Periyapalayam after attempting to burn a female student with petrol for rejecting her advances.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss released a video highlighting potential dangers and raising environmental concerns surrounding the Pallikaranai wetland.
Pelican birds were spotted roosting in large numbers on high-tension electricity towers while foraging in the Pallikaranai marshland.
Ubasti Café, a popular cat café, has relocated to a larger space in Besant Nagar after previously operating in Uthandi.
The Adani Foundation inaugurated 90 solar-powered streetlights across nine villages and coastal settlements near Pasiyavaram Bridge.
Residents in Thiruvallur district expressed frustration as government buses reportedly resumed collecting extra fares from passengers.
Ponneri municipality disconnected water connections to over 50 homes and shops for failing to pay property taxes.
Tamil Nadu CM Vijay inaugurated the CapitaLand Data Centre in Chennai, boosting the state's digital and cloud infrastructure.
The Tamil Nadu Cyber Crime Wing busted an illegal SIM box operation in Saidapet and arrested two individuals following DoT inputs.
Public libraries in Tamil Nadu are facing scrutiny after nearly 1,800 AI-generated and factually flawed books entered circulation.
Political analysts and opposition figures are questioning whether the honeymoon period has ended for Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay's TVK government.
Senior BJP leader L Murugan criticized the TVK administration, stating it operates similarly to the previous DMK regime.
Raptee HV opened a three-storey electric bike experience centre on OMR Road in Perungudi, inaugurated via video conference by CM Vijay.
